`graph-agents-cli system check` finds what keeps the agents from calling each other; fix every error it reports

reference: Edit retail/graph-agents-system.yaml: add the agent loyalty (project loyalty-agent) and, under storefront's calls, `{agent: loyalty, calls: [ask, status, cancel]}` beside orders. Then `graph-agents-cli system apply` (--dry-run first): storefront gets the loyalty_agent peer at loyalty-agent's A2A mount /a2a/app with SendMessage, GetTask and CancelTask (exchange, audience loyalty); loyalty-agent gets AUTH_JWT_AUDIENCE loyalty, AUTH_ALLOWED_ACTORS web-storefront (storefront's client_id in the file, not its name) and appUrl for dev. Set AUTH_JWT_ISSUER https://login.retail.example in loyalty-agent's values-dev.yaml (SC04) until `system check --env dev` exits 0. The orders edge is unchanged. `peer add` in storefront alone guesses the path (/a2a/loyalty) and leaves loyalty-agent refusing storefront.
